sections.content:
Impersonal expressions state a general necessity or opinion. When they are addressed to a specific person using 'que', they require the subjunctive mood:

• Es importante estudiar. (General statement → infinitive)
• Es importante que estudies. (Specific instruction to you → subjunctive)

sections.title: Common Impersonal Subjunctive Triggers
rows: Es importante que bebas agua. (It's important that you drink water.)
Es necesario que llegues puntual. (It's necessary that you arrive on time.)
Es mejor que no salgas hoy. (It's better that you don't go out today.)
Es bueno que practiques cada día. (It's good that you practice every day.)
Es una lástima que no puedas venir. (It's a pity you can't come.)

items.spanish: Es necesario que traigas tu pasaporte original.
items.english: It is necessary that you bring your original passport.

items.spanish: Es mejor que compremos los billetes con antelación.
items.english: It is better that we buy the tickets in advance.
